_about: Act 1 (Lost Mine of Phandelver) first pass, from the balance sheet 'Act 1 Phandelver' tab. Rules: docs/v0.25/act1-phandelver-encounters.md.

enemies.name: Goblin
enemies.trait: Melee only in the intro fight.

enemies.name: Ripper (Klarg's wolf)
enemies.trait: Charger: when the fight starts, leaps onto the rearmost hero (closest to the heroes' back edge).

enemies.name: Klarg (bugbear)
enemies.trait: Surprise Attack (d20, ~12s): smashes his current target. Low 2d8+2, Mid 3d8+2, High 3d8+2 and stun 1s. No leap.

enemies.name: Glasstaff (Iarno)
enemies.trait: Attack: Magic Missile, 3 darts at the lowest-HP hero. Staff of Defense (d20, ~14s): Ward on himself 2d10+INT (High 3d10). Once, at half HP, teleports to the farthest corner.

enemies.name: Vine Blight
enemies.trait: Entangle (d20, ~12s): roots its target and heroes next to it for 1.5/2/3s, 1d6 each. Rooted heroes cast with Disadvantage.

enemies.name: Ash Zombie
enemies.trait: On death, inflicts 2 poison on adjacent heroes.

enemies.name: Flameskull
enemies.trait: Fireball (d20, ~13s): 3d6 (High 4d6) to its target and everyone next to them. Rejuvenation (once): drops its skull (20 HP, AC 10) for 6s; destroy it or it re-forms at half HP. A Radiant killing blow skips the skull.

enemies.name: Ghoul
enemies.trait: Two claws per attack; every 3rd hit on the same hero stuns it 0.5s.

enemies.name: Nezznar (Black Spider)
enemies.trait: Web (d20, ~12s): roots the 2 nearest heroes 2s/3s, 2d6 each. At half HP, Darkness: Stealth 3s, then reappears in a back corner.

enemies.name: Venomfang (green dragon)
enemies.trait: Large (2x2). Poison Breath (d20, ~13s): 3-square cone, 4d6 and inflict 3 poison (High 5). At half HP, Wing Buffet pushes adjacent heroes back 1 square.

enemies.name: King Grol (bugbear chief)
enemies.trait: Brutal Charge (d20, ~12s): charges the rearmost hero within 4 squares for 4d8+3, stun 1s (High 1.5s); else smashes his target. At half HP, attacks 30% faster.

encounters.name: Klarg's Cave
encounters.terrain: Flood channel: at 10s water rushes down the bottom row, pushing anyone in it 2 squares left.

encounters.name: Glasstaff's Hideout
encounters.terrain: A crevasse splits the enemy half with one bridge (1 square wide); Glasstaff starts behind it.

encounters.name: Thundertree
encounters.terrain: Ruined cottage walls block line of sight.

encounters.name: Forge of Spells
encounters.terrain: The Forge: a hero adjacent to it adds +1 die to their ability.

encounters.name: Nezznar, the Black Spider
encounters.terrain: Webbed squares: entering one roots you 1s.

encounters.name: Venomfang
encounters.terrain: Ruined tower: high ground, +1 range for heroes on it.

encounters.name: King Grol
encounters.terrain: Castle gate: a one-at-a-time choke point.
